ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor CLI flag fingerprint (--access-token, --propagated, --no-vm-kill, --safeboot-instance)
ucs.description: Detects execution of the ALPHV/BlackCat (Noberus) Rust ransomware binary by hunting on the bespoke CLI flags hard-coded in the encryptor — most notably the mandatory --access-token, plus --propagated/--child for SMB worming, --no-vm-kill[-names] for ESXi/Hyper-V VM teardown, --safeboot-instance/--safeboot-network for the signature safe-mode reboot, and --no-wall to suppress the ransom note. These switches are virtually unique to ALPHV among RaaS families.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill-names*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-snapshot-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--safeboot-instance*" OR Processes.process="*--safeboot-network*" OR Processes.process="*--no-wall*" OR Processes.process="*--child *") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor — CLI flag fingerprint
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--propagated", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-prop", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-kill-names", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill", "--safeboot-instance", "--safeboot-network", "--no-wall", "--child ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"             // strip machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor — CLI flag fingerprint (Sentinel via Windows 4688)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--propagated", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-kill-names", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill", "--safeboot-instance", "--safeboot-network", "--no-wall", "--child ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 8c1f7b4a-2e9d-4d3b-9b87-7a1f4d2c5e90
status: experimental
description: Detects the unique command-line flags hard-coded in the ALPHV/BlackCat (Noberus) Rust ransomware binary. The encryptor will not run without --access-token, and the safeboot/propagated/no-vm-kill switches are bespoke to this family.

    CommandLine|contains:

      - '--no-vm-snapshot-kill'

      - '--safeboot-network'

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV safe-mode reboot → shadow-copy wipe sequence on same host
ucs.description: ALPHV/Noberus uniquely reboots victims into Safe Mode with Networking via bcdedit before encrypting, to neutralise EDR drivers — then deletes VSS shadow copies and forces the safe-mode encryption pass. This UC correlates bcdedit `safeboot` modification with VSS/wmic shadow deletion on the same host within 30 minutes — a chain that's far more BlackCat-specific than either action alone.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as bins values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*")) by host _time span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where mvcount(bins) >= 2 AND mvfind(bins,"bcdedit.exe")>=0 AND (mvfind(bins,"vssadmin.exe")>=0 OR mvfind(bins,"wmic.exe")>=0) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV — bcdedit safe-mode + shadow-copy wipe on same host within 30m
let Lookback = 7d;
let SafeMode =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"      // safeboot, /set {current} safeboot network, etc.
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SBTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, SBUser = AccountName,
              SBCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SBParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ShadowKill =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy")
    | project VSSTime = Timestamp, DeviceName,
              VSSCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              VSSFile = FileName;
SafeMode
| join kind=inner ShadowKill on DeviceName
| where VSSTime between (SBTime - 5m .. SBTime + 30m)   // either order, tight window
| project SBTime, VSSTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', VSSTime, SBTime),
          DeviceName, SBUser, SBCmd, VSSFile, VSSCmd
| order by SBTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV — bcdedit safeboot + shadow-copy wipe (Sentinel via 4688)
let Lookback = 7d;
let SafeMode =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | project SBTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SBUser = SubjectUserName,
              SBCmd = CommandLine;
let ShadowKill =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
    | project VSSTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              VSSCmd = CommandLine,
              VSSBin = NewProcessName;
SafeMode
| join kind=inner ShadowKill on Computer
| where VSSTime between (SBTime - 5m .. SBTime + 30m)
| project SBTime, VSSTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', VSSTime, SBTime),
          Computer, SBUser, SBCmd, VSSBin, VSSCmd
| order by SBTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"Shadowcopy Delete"*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
| bin_action := if(ImageFileName=/bcdedit/i, "safeboot", "shadow_kill")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ collect([bin_action, CommandLine, ImageFileName]) | count(distinct=true, field=bin_action, as=action_kinds) })
| action_kinds >= 2
ucs.rationale: Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Sophos X-Ops both call out the safe-mode reboot trick as a BlackCat-distinctive ESXi/Windows tradecraft step (the binary even exposes --safeboot-instance/--safeboot-network flags). bcdedit safeboot modification is rare in benign environments, vssadmin delete shadows is rare in benign environments, and the two within a 30-minute window on the same host is essential
